title: Carrier Onboarding Form
subtitle: Carrier Onboarding: captures actual activity and handoff.
description: Carrier Onboarding Form covers carrier organization, operating authority, insurance, contacts, equipment, controls, and approval. The carrier onboarding coordinator records Carrier Onboarding activity, quantities, variance, and handoff. Carrier Onboarding Form keeps Carrier Onboarding exceptions visible until the carrier onboarding coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Carrier Onboarding Form at carrier file, qualification system, dispatch access, and document repository. Document carrier organization, operating authority, insurance, contacts, equipment, controls, and approval identity before Carrier Onboarding begins. Compare carrier organization, operating authority, insurance, contacts, equipment, controls, and approval findings with stated Carrier Onboarding criteria; route unresolved Carrier Onboarding issues to authorized carrier-compliance reviewer. For Carrier Onboarding Form, confirm requirements for Carrier Onboarding. Ask authorized carrier-compliance reviewer to review Carrier Onboarding conditions beyond the carrier onboarding coordinator's role.
